android-data-display|Activity feed.summary: A Plenix timeline on Android is a column of events in order, each a neutral marker on one line with its date in Reddit Mono, a title and a line or two about it; down the screen on a phone, across it for a few milestones on a large screen. Material 3 has no timeline component: Plenix draws the markers and the line in Compose (or a RecyclerView item decoration) with its own roles, and an event’s state is a Plenix badge after its title, never the marker’s color. TalkBack reads each event as one node: its time, title and description.

anatomy.name: Line
anatomy.about: Joins the markers in the order of the events, in the strong border color.

anatomy.name: Marker
anatomy.about: A small ringed circle, or the event’s icon in a circle; neutral, never a state color.

anatomy.name: Time
anatomy.about: The date or time in Reddit Mono, in the muted color, as tall as the marker so the two share a middle.

anatomy.name: Title and badge
anatomy.about: What happened, semibold, with a Plenix badge after it for the event’s state.

anatomy.name: Description
anatomy.about: A line or two about the event, in the muted color.
